requirement: Install fpdf2 ≥2.8.1 and python-dateutil ≥2.9.0 (Step 0).
actual: Backend dependency manifest contains both; isolated installation and PDF generation succeed.
gap: Root setup/CI dependency drift is separate (I07).
fix: KEEP backend declarations; align the root install entry point.

requirement: Three city metadata records, default Chennai, centers, zooms and municipal names (Step 1).
actual: Chennai, Bangalore and Delhi configuration loads and list/switch APIs return metadata.
gap: No missing configuration fields found; this is configuration coverage, not operational multi-city isolation.
fix: KEEP city configuration.

requirement: City-specific roads, waypoint weights, POIs and contractors (Step 1).
actual: Each city has its own lookup inputs; dynamic functions select the configured city.
gap: Small manually curated samples are not complete municipal GIS coverage.
fix: KEEP as demo fixtures; validate and expand through a data import later.

requirement: City zone dictionaries (Step 1).
actual: Zone labels exist in configuration and are returned by /api/cities/config.
gap: Labels have no polygons or detection-to-zone assignment; see P1-18.
fix: KEEP labels; add zone assignment when implementing report breakdowns.

requirement: Four repair-rate entries and default 2 m² cost arithmetic (Steps 1–2).
actual: D00/D10/D20/D40 rates and rate × area function follow the supplied plan.
gap: This verifies the prescribed calculation, not the claim that these are approved IRC rates or measured areas.
fix: KEEP arithmetic; version and source rates; clearly label assumed areas.

requirement: Load JSON and expose active-city get/set with invalid-city error (Step 2).
actual: JSON is loaded; keys are normalized; an unknown city raises ValueError; switch maps it to HTTP 400.
gap: Process-global city follows the plan but creates I03 in multi-user use.
fix: KEEP validation; migrate the active selection to request scope for production.

requirement: City summary for dropdown including active state (Step 2).
actual: Summary returns key/name/state/center/zoom/body/is_active.
gap: None against the specified summary contract.
fix: KEEP — no change required.

requirement: Haversine distance helper (Step 2).
actual: Great-circle calculation is used by POI/road functions and SQLite clustering; 20.015 m fixture verified.
gap: No defect found in this helper for tested coordinates.
fix: KEEP — no change required.

requirement: Road importance and nearest configured waypoint matching (Step 2).
actual: Weight fallback and minimum-distance waypoint match follow the supplied algorithm.
gap: A waypoint is not a road geometry; calling it OSM snapping overstates the implementation.
fix: KEEP for demo; label approximate matching and later use road geometries if accuracy requires it.

requirement: POI thresholds at 500/1,500/3,000 metres (Step 2).
actual: Nearest POI and normalized weights 1/.75/.5/.25 are calculated dynamically.
gap: No missing threshold branch found.
fix: KEEP — no change required; maintain boundary tests.

requirement: Contractor/SLA lookup with city fallback (Step 2).
actual: Configured road contractors and municipal fallback are returned.
gap: These are sample assignments, not verified contractor registrations or dispatch integrations.
fix: KEEP lookup; expose fixture provenance.

requirement: PDF branding, city, UTC generation time and page footer (Step 3).
actual: Generated PDF has header, city, timestamp and numbered footer; visually rendered and checked.
gap: No blocking layout problem in the tested two-row report.
fix: KEEP — no change required for the basic template.

requirement: Executive summary accurately describing last 30 days (Step 3).
actual: PDF says last 30 days, but the query includes 60-day-old records.
gap: Plan sample itself queries latest 500 without date filtering. The stated reporting period is false.
fix: Apply explicit start/end filters, print those dates and disclose any export limit.

requirement: Damage classification counts and estimated budgets (Step 3).
actual: Counts and budgets are calculated from supplied detections using the plan’s per-row rule.
gap: Duplicate passes are charged as separate repairs; this is a plan-design problem (I04), not an omitted loop.
fix: Retain the table; calculate the operational budget from unique active repair scopes.

requirement: Road-wise defect table, contractors and SLA hours (Step 3).
actual: Road aggregation and contractor/SLA columns appear in the generated PDF.
gap: Long names are truncated; no multi-page stress/layout test completed.
fix: KEEP structure; wrap text and repeat table headers on page breaks.

requirement: SLA age/deadline calculation specified in sample (Step 3).
actual: Compares each detection time plus contractor SLA against now, exactly as the plan describes.
gap: Labelled contractor compliance although no assignment/resolution data is used; fixed “48-Hour” heading contradicts variable SLAs.
fix: Keep date arithmetic; change to work-order due_at/resolved_at and truthful labels (I04).

requirement: Accurate methodology in the municipal PDF (Step 3).
actual: Methodology says min 2 samples, 28.4 ms and sovereign training; runtime uses min 1 and several claims lack evidence.
gap: Copied text does not describe the executing system.
fix: Generate methodology from versioned, verified model/deployment metadata.

requirement: Zone breakdowns promised in report module description (Step 3 introduction).
actual: No zone aggregation section or zone mapping is implemented.
gap: The plan’s prose promises zones but its example code omits them. Marked missing against prose; ambiguity is disclosed.
fix: Define zone boundaries/assignment; add zone totals, or formally remove this requirement.

requirement: CSV export with 12 meaningful fields (Step 3).
actual: All 12 headers exist and CSV downloads; Confidence % holds 0.9, and Zone is empty.
gap: Units are wrong and one promised field has no source.
fix: Convert confidence to percent or rename it; populate zone; neutralize spreadsheet formulas.

requirement: JSON/PDF/CSV report route and attachment responses (Step 4).
actual: All three implemented formats return successfully in local execution.
gap: Unknown format=xml also returns JSON: the plan’s enum metadata is not runtime validation.
fix: KEEP routes; use a Literal/Enum and return 422 for unsupported values.

requirement: JSON counts, budget, UTC timestamp and 50-row preview from latest 500 (Step 4).
actual: Field structure and limits match sample; implementation correctly adapts nonexistent plan field names to timestamp/defect_type.
gap: No pagination or truncation notice; preview/summary range must be clear.
fix: KEEP schema adaptation; expose total available and limit metadata.

requirement: GET /api/cities metadata and active key (Step 4).
actual: Local endpoint returns configured cities and active selection.
gap: None against this narrow contract.
fix: KEEP — no change required.

requirement: POST /api/cities/switch validates key and returns center/zoom (Step 4).
actual: Authenticated local switch succeeds and persists for that process.
gap: Added API-key check is appropriate; global state is a separate architectural defect inherited from the sample.
fix: KEEP response/validation; replace global context as in I03.

requirement: GET /api/cities/config returns “full” configuration (Step 4).
actual: Returns metadata, zones and road/POI counts; omits actual roads, POIs and contractors.
gap: Matches example body but not its full-configuration docstring; map cannot hydrate city GIS layers from this response.
fix: Resolve spec ambiguity; return the needed GIS collections and a version.

requirement: Fleet helper updates an existing row instead of appending (Step 5).
actual: Two HTTP helper updates for one vehicle leave one row.
gap: Read-then-write is not concurrency safe without a unique key.
fix: KEEP intent; enforce unique vehicle_id and use a database upsert.

requirement: Prevent unbounded fleet-position growth across ingestion (Step 5 purpose).
actual: HTTP path upserts; MQTT heartbeat path still inserts one row per heartbeat.
gap: The optimization is not applied to every writer; OD analysis also still expects historical rows.
fix: Separate latest position from retained trajectory history; apply shared ingestion logic.

requirement: METRICS.md includes model, compression, bandwidth, spatial and tests sections (Step 6).
actual: All five sections and requested fields are present and were read.
gap: Document completeness is not verification of its numerical claims.
fix: KEEP sections; replace unsupported values using P1-28–33 evidence.

requirement: Training/validation metrics are real for the shipped model (Step 6).
actual: mAP/P/R/F1 and 7,706 images are asserted; no reproducible evaluation bundle ties them to shipped model hashes.
gap: Training README describes a synthetic smoke dataset; commit says 30 epochs/960, metrics says 100/640. This does not prove which checkpoint was exported.
fix: Publish dataset split provenance, training args, evaluation output and model SHA256.

requirement: INT8 size/compression values represent shipped files (Step 6).
actual: INT8 is 3,356,689 bytes, FP32 12,268,188 bytes; reduction ≈72.64%.
gap: Rounded 3.2 is MiB, while 12.2 is approximately decimal MB: units are inconsistent.
fix: KEEP artifacts; use bytes and one consistent unit.

requirement: 28.4/64.2 ms and 2.26× latency benchmark (Step 6).
actual: A host inference smoke test ran, but the claimed paired benchmark/hardware setup is not reproducible from published results.
gap: Apple Silicon benchmark and projected Raspberry Pi numbers are not interchangeable.
fix: Publish warmup/sample count, preprocessing, hardware, thread count and p50/p95 for both models.

requirement: 200-byte MQTT, 99.8% savings and MQTT v5 claim (Step 6).
actual: Client library v2 is used, but clients do not select MQTT v5; event rate and thumbnail traffic are absent from savings derivation.
gap: Library major version is not protocol version; bandwidth percentage lacks a time basis.
fix: Set protocol explicitly if v5 is required; measure bytes/sec at defined detection rates.

requirement: Published PostGIS version and min_samples=2 match deployment (Step 6).
actual: Compose uses PostgreSQL 16 / PostGIS 3.4; code uses minpoints/min_samples=1; hosted region/version not verified.
gap: Published description conflicts with runnable configuration.
fix: Choose supported versions and promotion policy, implement them and update every source of claims.

requirement: Existing tests still pass and documented test evidence is current (Steps 6/checklist).
actual: Full run: 61 passed, 1 failed; latest GitHub CI cannot import slowapi; metrics still says 46/100%/2.08 s.
gap: Neither current full pass claim nor setup reproducibility holds.
fix: Unify dependencies, fix auth-aware legacy test, publish test command and dated results.

requirement: Multi-city municipal behavior works end-to-end (Steps 1/2/4 integration intent).
actual: Bangalore report contains Chennai detections; switched dashboard retains Chennai map/POIs.
gap: Configuration switching does not isolate observations, requests or exports.
fix: Carry city_id through schema, API and UI query state; recenter and reload city layers.

requirement: Install @fontsource/jetbrains-mono and import the specified weights (Step 0).
actual: Package and font imports are absent; Tailwind names an unloaded family.
gap: No bundled JetBrains Mono is supplied as requested.
fix: Install/import it, or explicitly accept the already bundled Geist alternative and wire its CSS variable.

requirement: Command-center palette tokens (Step 1).
actual: vc background/panel/border and five neon accents match specified values.
gap: Components often use raw Slate classes and a different body background; that is design-system adoption debt.
fix: KEEP token definitions; consolidate actual usage.

requirement: Mono/display font tokens work with loaded fonts (Step 1).
actual: Token names exist, but declared Geist variables are not used in these family lists; JetBrains is not loaded.
gap: Falls back to system monospace; typography differs by device.
fix: Bind font-sans/font-mono to actual loaded variables; verify computed fonts.

requirement: Neon/glass shadows and xs backdrop blur tokens (Step 1).
actual: Specified shadow and blur definitions are present and used by cockpit/glass components.
gap: Excessive decorative layering is a usability issue, not a missing token.
fix: KEEP available tokens; restrict glow to meaningful status.

requirement: Five command-center keyframes and animation utilities (Steps 1–2).
actual: Radar, pulse, fill, slide-up and breathe definitions exist; animation observed in live/local pages.
gap: No reduced-motion override found.
fix: KEEP short transitions; add reduced-motion behavior.

requirement: Severity glow styles and four stat-card/gauge variants (Step 2).
actual: CSS utilities and SeverityBadge styles provide semantic colored badges and gauges.
gap: CSS utilities overlap inline gradients and Tailwind variants.
fix: KEEP semantic palette; use a single implementation per component.

requirement: HardwareCockpit four prescribed metrics and gauge labels (Step 3).
actual: Code supplies 3.2 MB, 28.4 ms, 99.8%, ₹2,800 with reference subtitles and percentages.
gap: Literal widget content matches the plan; underlying benchmark/BOM claims remain unverified.
fix: KEEP configurable card structure; label benchmark fixtures and cite measured hardware.

requirement: Expand/collapse interaction (Step 3).
actual: State toggle/animation exists, but expanded body is clipped by the containing dashboard layout.
gap: User cannot reliably see expanded metrics at tested laptop/mobile sizes; no aria-expanded.
fix: Make panel content reachable in a scrolling area and expose disclosure semantics.

requirement: Simulated accelerometer changes every 800 ms with 3.5 threshold (Step 3).
actual: Random 0.5–5.0 values, threshold and BUMP/IDLE state follow the plan.
gap: Plan explicitly requests simulation; presenting it as real sensor telemetry is the separate defect.
fix: KEEP only in explicitly labelled demo mode.

requirement: Twenty-four vibration bars and threshold state display (Step 3).
actual: Random bar visualization and monitoring/capturing captions are implemented.
gap: These are not measured frequency bins or acquisition state.
fix: Label illustrative; replace with measured samples when hardware is connected.

requirement: Metric cards responsively remain visible (Step 3/checklist).
actual: lg:grid-cols-4 is based on viewport width inside a narrow sidebar; panel also shrinks almost to its header.
gap: Four cards may exist in DOM but fail the visual acceptance criterion.
fix: Use a 2-column sidebar grid/container query and remove flex shrink clipping.

requirement: City selector fetches list and uses three-city fallback (Step 4).
actual: Fetch/fallback options exist; all three are visible in local dropdown.
gap: Fallback use is not announced to the user.
fix: KEEP list behavior; add offline/demo provenance.

requirement: Outside click closes dropdown and loading disables choices (Step 4).
actual: Outside-click listener cleanup and disabled={isLoading} are implemented.
gap: Keyboard Escape/arrow navigation and a mobile accessible name are incomplete.
fix: KEEP behavior; add menu/listbox semantics and keyboard support.

requirement: POST selected city and invoke onCityChange callback (Step 4).
actual: Local UI switches backend to Bangalore and updates button.
gap: The plan’s sample does not require HTTP status verification, but failure handling is misleading.
fix: KEEP transport; require response.ok before committing selection.

requirement: Local switch fallback on backend failure (Step 4).
actual: Catch path switches local display exactly as supplied plan.
gap: This hides failures if the rest of the page remains on another city.
fix: Keep fallback only in explicit demo mode; otherwise rollback and display an error.

requirement: Integrate city selector into header action group (Step 6).
actual: Inserted in the specified area; present at desktop, clipped off-screen on tablet/mobile.
gap: Insertion is complete; responsive access fails.
fix: Move city to a compact first-class selector and collapse secondary actions.

requirement: Selected city drives the dashboard/map (Step 6 stated goal; recenter optional in sample).
actual: Header callback only logs; no city query state or GIS replacement reaches the dashboard.
gap: Sample labels recenter optional; full multi-city intent remains unmet.
fix: Use shared selectedCity state; pass it to data queries and MapLibre camera/layers.

requirement: Reusable four-type Web Audio synthesis (Step 5).
actual: pothole/crack/plate/vehicle configurations, dual oscillator and gain envelope implemented.
gap: This is a source-reviewed callable helper; audible output was not independently measured.
fix: KEEP helper; resume AudioContext after user gesture.

requirement: Type-specific vibration patterns and safe unsupported-browser fallback (Step 5).
actual: Four patterns and guarded audio/vibration calls match the specification.
gap: Physical vibration support unverified on a handset.
fix: KEEP guards; verify on target Android/iOS devices.

requirement: DetectionChime is used by capture events (Step 5 integration intent).
actual: Capture defines its own generic function with same name; does not import the new four-type helper.
gap: New component is effectively dead; distinct event cues do not reach this flow.
fix: Import the shared helper and map actual event classes to cue types.

requirement: Preloader initializes audio after first interaction (Step 5 helper comment).
actual: Preloader returns null with no listener or initialization.
gap: Plan sample is itself a no-op despite its comment.
fix: Either implement one user-gesture initialization or delete misleading preloader claim.

requirement: Mount HardwareCockpit in dashboard (Step 7).
actual: Dashboard imports and mounts it; live changing header visible.
gap: Rendering is proven; visibility failure is counted in P2-11.
fix: KEEP mounting; fix container layout.

requirement: Production TypeScript/build verification (checklist).
actual: npm ci and npm run build complete successfully.
gap: Build success does not establish responsive or data-flow correctness.
fix: KEEP build check; add targeted UI/contract tests.

requirement: Browser verification of all four cards, gauge and cities (checklist).
actual: City choices/gauge observed; all metrics not simultaneously usable in the tested dashboard layouts.
gap: Checklist cannot be signed off from DOM presence.
fix: Retest actual expanded cards at 1440/1366/768/390 widths.

requirement: Chime/haptic end-user verification (checklist).
actual: Source inspected; no permission-granted physical camera/phone audio/haptic test performed.
gap: Actual audible/haptic success on target hardware remains unknown.
fix: Run a short physical-device acceptance test after integration fix.

requirement: Three named demo clips exist and are decodable (Step 1).
actual: All three open with OpenCV and yielded inspected frames.
gap: This is media decoding, not proof of real-world detection.
fix: KEEP filenames and deterministic smoke media.

requirement: Indian road, traffic and readable-plate scenes suitable for model demo (Step 1).
actual: Clips are generated/composited scenes; a synthetic fallback is explicitly permitted as last resort.
gap: They do not validate real road/traffic/ANPR performance.
fix: Label synthetic; add consented/licensed real clips and verified detection outputs.

requirement: 10–15 seconds, 720p/1080p and under 20 MB per demo clip (Step 1).
gap: All satisfy these dimensional limits.
fix: KEEP — no change required.

requirement: H.264 encoding for demo clips (Step 1 verification).
actual: Measured codec tag FMP4 (MPEG-4 Part 2), not H.264.
gap: Browser simulator showed Unable to play media in local inspection; full codec-specific support matrix not tested.
fix: Re-encode H.264/yuv420p with faststart and verify browser playback.

requirement: Pothole card at least 1200×800 (Step 2).
actual: Shipped card is exactly 1200×800 and was visually inspected.
gap: Pixel dimensions do not prove detection suitability.
fix: KEEP dimensions; choose an image the real model demonstrably detects.

requirement: Required plate cards MH12AB1234 and TN07CK4523, printable dimensions (Step 2).
actual: Both exist at 800×200; extra KA/TN cards also present.
gap: Synthetic test identifiers are appropriate for a safe demo.
fix: KEEP — no change required for file preparation.

requirement: A4 printing/lamination and cards present at venue (Step 2).
actual: Repository contains images and print instructions only.
gap: Physical execution cannot be checked remotely from code.
fix: Print and perform the venue checklist; record dated acceptance evidence.

requirement: Each card actually detected by phone camera (Step 2).
actual: No physical phone test; direct pothole-image inference returns zero boxes at 0.45 and 0.25 on this host.
gap: One negative image smoke test is not a model accuracy estimate; acceptance remains unproven.
fix: Verify each prepared card with the shipped browser model and capture settings.

requirement: Readable six-minute runbook with assigned presenters (Step 3).
actual: DEMO_SCRIPT contains six-minute segment table and named responsibilities.
gap: Runbook existence does not verify its claims.
fix: KEEP timed structure.

requirement: Preflight/start commands, Wi-Fi, device and backup checklist (Step 3).
actual: Checklist is detailed, but fresh-install dependency/auth/phone HTTPS prerequisites are incomplete.
gap: A clean clone can fail before the scripted demonstration.
fix: Replace with tested commands, explicit environment profile and HTTPS phone URL.

requirement: Dashboard demonstration proves ingestion→cluster→RPI→dispatch (Step 3).
actual: Local HTTP ingestion/RPI/status update work; WebSocket fails and dispatch is a status field only.
gap: Scripted automated contractor dispatch and verification exceed implemented behavior.
fix: Show only proven workflow; add actual assignment/history before claiming dispatch.

requirement: Phone capture demonstrates real AI and sub-200ms cloud/map update (Step 3).
actual: Real model files exist; camera/device/network latency was not measured end-to-end.
gap: Simulation and BroadcastChannel do not validate cross-device delivery.
fix: Run timed phone→server→separate-laptop test with explicit model/source labels.

requirement: Live video demonstrates all three real models (Step 3).
actual: Stream code runs model adapters, but ANPR lacks declared runtime dependencies and may simulate; no ingestion to map.
gap: Colored boxes alone cannot prove three functioning models.
fix: Install explicit edge profile; report model readiness; publish validated clip outputs.

requirement: Chief-engineer export demonstration is reliable (Step 3).
actual: Local PDF/CSV responses work; hosted rewrite points to localhost:8000 and report scope is incorrect.
gap: Downloadable file is not a valid municipal report.
fix: Repair environment routing and report population before recording the demo.

requirement: Q&A statements are defensible from implementation (Step 3).
actual: Runbook asserts state-of-the-art accuracy, queued offline sync, verified fail-safe and hardware claims without supporting evidence.
gap: Some claims directly contradict code or media artifacts.
fix: Rewrite answers to distinguish measured, simulated, projected and planned functionality.

requirement: 90-second failsafe under 50 MB (Step 4).
actual: File is 90.0 seconds and 18.06 MB.
gap: Duration/size pass independently of content authenticity.
fix: KEEP duration/size target.

requirement: Failsafe is 1920×1080 recording (Step 4).
actual: File is 1280×720.
gap: Explicit output resolution not met.
fix: Record at 1920×1080 and verify metadata.

requirement: Failsafe records actual dashboard→popup→city→cockpit→AI→PDF sequence (Step 4).
actual: Video is programmatically drawn by OpenCV; inspected frame contains a mock city panel rather than the application.
gap: It is an illustration, not evidence that the app performed the actions.
fix: Record the real working application after fixes; retain visible source/demo labels.

requirement: Failsafe copied to USB and ready offline (Step 4).
actual: No physical USB/venue inspection.
gap: Cannot infer physical preparation from a file in Git.
fix: Check offline playback on the actual presentation machine and USB.

requirement: Architecture slide shows prescribed Phone→INT8→MQTT→FastAPI→PostGIS→Next PWA flow (Step 5).
actual: Root deck has many required names, but legacy multi-camera/Flutter/Leaflet/Mapbox descriptions remain.
gap: Not one unambiguous diagram of the shipped system; phone path actually uses HTTP.
fix: Update a single canonical diagram to match runtime transports.

requirement: AI slide includes mAP 39.89 / P 54.3 / R 37.4 and 7,706 images (Step 5).
actual: Root slide 3 includes mAP/image count; extracted slide text lacks requested precision/recall.
gap: Incomplete figures; underlying evaluation remains P1-28 unverified.
fix: Add only reproducible metrics with model/dataset version and limits.

requirement: Hardware slide includes 3.2 MB / 28.4 ms/2.26×/99.8%/₹2800 (Step 5).
actual: Some size/latency/bandwidth text appears; complete set not present; later deck cites PiZero/phone while UI cites Pi4.
gap: No coherent measured hardware configuration.
fix: Use one measured BOM/benchmark table and label projections.

requirement: Database/MQTT slide lists versions and 15 m clustering (Step 5).
actual: Root slide 3 includes PostgreSQL 17 / PostGIS 3.3, 15 m and MQTT v5.
gap: Literal slide requirement met; facts conflict with configuration (P1-31/32).
fix: Update plan and deck together to verified deployed versions.

requirement: Priority slide includes RPI and FHWA formula (Step 5).
actual: RPI appears; requested FHWA formula not found in root deck extracted text.
gap: No complete formula coverage or verified standard provenance.
fix: Add the implemented congestion formula and identify RPI as project-defined unless sourced.

requirement: Testing slide: 46 tests / 2.08 s / 100% (Step 5).
actual: Requested test evidence not found in extracted root-deck text; embedded-image contents were not fully verified.
gap: Cannot certify absence from all slide images. The exact values are also stale; copying them would not be an acceptable fix.
fix: Insert current full test result and command after CI passes.

requirement: Scalability slide names Chennai/Bangalore/Delhi and configuration (Step 5).
actual: Root slide 4 includes the cities and city_config.json.
gap: This is configuration-level support; operational isolation fails.
fix: KEEP names; qualify current support until I03 is fixed.

requirement: Budget slide includes D40 ₹4,500/m² and D20 ₹2,800/m² (Step 5).
actual: Both values appear, but ₹2,800 is broadly labelled “crack” and standard label differs.
gap: Ambiguous class attribution and rate source.
fix: Name exact defect class, unit, rate source/date and area assumption.

requirement: Dark/cyan presentation style and prescribed fonts (Step 5).
actual: OOXML/text/media inspected; slides were not fully rendered in PowerPoint.
gap: Cannot certify whole-slide typography, overflow, colors and alignment from text extraction.
fix: Open/render the canonical deck and verify every slide visually.

requirement: Embed six screenshots: dashboard, cockpit, cities, live inference, PDF and tests (Step 5).
actual: Deck media inventory exists, but all six current screenshots could not be verified as rendered slide content.
gap: Media presence alone is insufficient; alignment script only replaces text.
fix: Capture current outputs and visually verify each embedded screenshot.

requirement: Entire demo rehearsed against actual integrated services (final checklist).
actual: Independent build/API/UI checks expose WebSocket, capture auth, city/report and failsafe failures.
gap: No evidence supports signing off the prescribed full sequence.
fix: Run one uninterrupted rehearsal from a clean install after Phase 1 fixes.
